title: 谷歌Pixel Watch 5深度整合AI与健康功能
summary: 谷歌最新发布的Pixel Watch 5智能手表售价399美元，较上代上涨50美元。本次升级重点并非硬件，而是深度整合AI与健康功能。硬件方面仅提供新的缎面黄铁矿表壳、几款新表带颜色以及斯蒂芬·库里特别版，内部搭载稍快的骁龙处理器和略微增大的电池。该设备强调通过Gemini AI提升用户体验，尤其在健康监测和个性化建议方面。尽管硬件升级有限，但AI功能的深化可能为用户带来更智能的健康管理、更精准的运动追踪和更自然的语音交互。此次发布反映了谷歌在可穿戴设备领域将AI作为核心差异化策略，旨在通过软件生态和智能服务吸引用户，而非单纯依赖硬件迭代。
summary_en: Google's latest Pixel Watch 5, priced at $399 (a $50 increase from last year), focuses not on hardware but on deeper integration of AI and health features. Hardware upgrades are minimal, including a new satin pyrite case finish, a few new strap colors, a Steph Curry Special Edition, a slightly faster Qualcomm processor, and a minor battery bump. The device emphasizes AI-driven health monitoring and personalized insights, likely powered by Gemini AI. This strategy highlights Google's shift toward software and AI as key differentiators in the competitive smartwatch market, aiming to deliver smarter health management and enhanced user experiences despite modest hardware changes.
